pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.2: tena kho pana samayena Caṇḍakālī bhikkhunī kismiñcid eva adhikaraṇe paccākatā kupitā anattamanā evaṃ vadeti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.3: chandagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo dosagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo mohagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo bhayagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.5: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā Caṇḍakālī bhikkhunī kismiñcid eva . . . evaṃ vakkhati . . .
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.7: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave Caṇḍakālī bhikkhunī kismiñcid eva . . . evaṃ vadeti . . .
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.11: hi nāma bhikkhave Caṇḍakālī bhikkhunī kismiñcid eva . . . evaṃ vakkhati . . .
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.15.1: yā pana bhikkhunī kismiñcid eva adhikaraṇe paccākatā kupitā anattamanā evaṃ vadeyya:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.16: chandagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo --pa-- bhayagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo 'ti,
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.17: sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi evam assa vacanīyā:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.18: māyye kismiñcid eva adhikaraṇe paccākatā kupitā anattamanā evaṃ avaca:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.19: chandagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo --pa-- bhayagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.20: ayyā kho chandāpi gaccheyya dosāpi gaccheyya mohāpi gaccheyya bhayāpi gaccheyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.21: evañ ca sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi vuccamānā tath' eva paggaṇheyya, sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbā tassa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.22: yāvatatiyañ ce samanubhāsiyamānā taṃ paṭinissajjeyya, icc etaṃ kusalaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.23: no ce paṭinissajjeyya, ayam pi bhikkhunī yāvatatiyakaṃ dhammaṃ āpannā nissāraṇīyaṃ saṃghādisesan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:2.1.6: adhikaraṇan nāma cattāri adhikaraṇāni vivādādhikaraṇaṃ anuvādādhikaraṇaṃ āpattādhikaraṇaṃ kiccādhikaraṇaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:2.1.12: chandagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo --pa-- bhayagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:2.1.16: aññāhi bhikkhunīhi yā passanti yā suṇanti tāhi vattabbā:
